message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, thereby extending the weekend to three days (or more if the holiday is observed on a different day).

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Type | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Friday‑holiday** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **Monday‑holiday** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Monday‑holiday** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Monday‑holiday** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Monday‑holiday** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon). |

### Provincial/Regional Long‑Weekends (selected examples)

| Province | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Type |
|----------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Ontario | Family Day | February 20 (Monday) | **Monday‑holiday** (but not a long weekend because the preceding weekend is not extended). |
| British Columbia | St. Patricks Day | March 17 (Friday) | **Friday‑holiday** (creates a long weekend). |
| Alberta | Heritage Day | September 15 (Monday) | **Monday‑holiday** (creates a long weekend). |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | June 24 (Friday) | **Friday‑holiday** (creates a long weekend). |

> **Note:** Some provinces observe additional holidays that may create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, etc.). The table above lists only the federal holidays that universally create long weekends across Canada in 2023.

Feel free to integrate this data into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of provincial holidays or want to adjust for observed dates (when a holiday falls on a weekend and is moved to a weekday), let me know!
